storylines.title: Prologue: The Revolt
storylines.about: The year 2500. The world has fallen back to muskets and sail. A revolt flares against the Crown.

still.caption: The Crown's camp on the east bank: tents, a map table under an awning, the sergeant by the fire.

lines: Farmers with muskets, sir. They have courage, I'll grant the varlets that.
Mind the ford: it's narrow, and they'll be waiting on the far bank.
Quiet as a churchyard, that village, now.
There's talk in the camp, sir: of things under the earth, and clocks that walk.
The Crown wants this revolt ended, and quickly. Zounds, I'd rather be home.
Study the war table, then we march.
Well done. By my troth, the Crown has stranger troubles than farmers now.
Two letters came: one from an explorer of the deep earth, one from a clockmaker. Read them both.

storylines.title: The Explorer
storylines.about: A Catholic explorer goes down into the deep earth and finds the Brood. (Being written.)

still.caption: A ship's cabin lit by a lantern: charts of caverns, a crucifix, a cage of strange eggs.

storylines.title: The Clockmaker
storylines.about: A clockmaker grows afraid of his own Clockwork. (Being written.)

still.caption: A workshop of gears and springs; a half-built Clock Soldier on the bench, a priest at the door.

armoury.title: ARMOURY
armoury.text: Upgrades between missions will be bought here. (Not decided yet: a placeholder.)
